statement: The checked-in global owner-debt tooling inventory is the exact deterministic projection of the fully composed Wave 0 source and Solver graph without source, generator, or baseline changes. doneWhen: solve/oracle/global-owner-debt-inventory-tooling-projection-refresh-wave0.json reaches zero only when the official refresh is idempotent, the focused inventory test and complete Solver suite pass, and independent review confirms that only derived owner-debt facts changed.

Refresh only after every Wave 0 source lane, including Solver static and operator-park evidence identity, is present in the candidate tree.
